current: The platform's one documented schema-migration discipline for its own wire schemas is a single-step bump that makes an older consumer stop, which is what this row forbids. qip_contracts::wire::CELL_DELTA_SCHEMA_VERSION (wire.rs:122-148) says 'Raise it whenever the delta's wire shape changes in a way an older reader would misunderstand... a bump means an unupgraded centre goes quiet about the cells that have moved ahead of it', and versions 2-4 were each additive fields deliberately made breaking. qip-mesh's WireDelta decodes through AnyEvent::decode (delta.rs:149), which refuses any payload newer than the reader (envelope.rs:129-136), so every version bump is breaking for every older consumer by construction; qip-api's composition root decodes cell deltas this way. No producer writes two forms, and SchemaRegistry refuses two body types on one topic (registry.rs:69-77). The only additive-compatible rule in the tree is qip-market-ingestion's connector SchemaVersion (newer minor admitted, newer major refused), which governs external vendor source schemas, not the platform's own.
gap: No additive-first rule for platform schemas, no dual-write producer, no dual-read consumer and no migration phase; the documented discipline for the cell uplink is the single-step breaking bump the requirement's rationale rules out, and the one-type-per-topic registry rule blocks a producer from writing two shapes of one topic. Meeting the row means changing that discipline (e.g. a versioned topic or an envelope carrying both forms during a window), not only adding code.
notes: verify: reclassified MISSING -> INCORRECT. The assessor missed that a migration discipline does exist for the platform's own wire schema (CELL_DELTA_SCHEMA_VERSION, wire.rs:122-148) and it is single-step: every bump makes an older reader refuse and 'go quiet', contradicting the verification clause 'a consumer on the old version keeps working'. It is reached from qip-api's composition root via qip_mesh::delta. The connector SchemaVersion major/minor rule covers vendor sources only.
